newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Bank/Portugal buys marks for escudos -dealers.
newsitem.headline: Bank/Portugal buys marks for escudos -dealers.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal was buying marks for escudos at around 100.01/02 escudos per mark, dealers said on Thursday.
Bank officials could not be immediately contacted for comment.
"The Bank is seeking to hold mark-escudo at around the figure (100), which is a strong psychological level," said one dealer.
The escudo is at its strongest against the mark for some three years.

The currency has been boosted by foreign buying of stocks on the Lisbon bourse and the strength of the dollar against the mark. The latter factor has also been lifting the Spanish peseta and the Italian lira.
